kimi-k3.1-pro.description: The first model of the new K3.1 series and Kimi's most capable flagship to date: a 3T-class model with native visual understanding and a 1M-token context window, delivering substantial improvements in coding, 3D creation, and financial research and modeling.
kimi-k3.1-pro.release_date_source: Platform Changelog: October 2026 - Batch API now supports Kimi K3.1 Pro (implied already available); no exact release date given, derived from October 2026 changelog entry and model listing.

kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed.description: The high-speed variant of Kimi K3.1 Pro — same intelligence, about 2-3× the speed.

kimi-k3.description: Kimi's previous-generation flagship and the world's first open-source 3T-class model (2.8 trillion parameters); with native visual understanding and a 1M-token context window, designed for frontier intelligence scenarios such as long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and deep reasoning.
kimi-k3.release_date_source: Platform Changelog: July 2026 - Kimi K3 available on the Open Platform API

kimi-k2.7-code.description: No longer available to newly registered users; users registered before November 1 can continue using it. Deprecation expected in late December 2026.

kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed.description: No longer available to newly registered users; users registered before November 1 can continue using it. Deprecation expected in late December 2026.
